data.sections.core.name: Unit Name
data.sections.core.name.description: Defines the unit raw name, game uses it to identify as a unique name. (This is not displayed in-game)
data.sections.core.mass.description: The 'weight' of the unit, defines how it collides with other units, a greater value means it's tougher to push.
data.sections.core.radius.description: Circular area around the unit that makes it selectable. (mouse click/screen touch)
data.sections.core.price.description: The unit cost from builders/buildings. Defaults to credits if no resource type is used
data.sections.core.maxHp.description: The max health for the unit. (will spawn with this value).
data.sections.core.buildSpeed.descriptio: Time it takes to build the unit. (may multiply with builder speed)
data.sections.core.class.description: Reserved for future use, must be CustomUnitMetadata by default. Is not necessary to include, has no additional functions.
data.sections.core.techLevel.description: Defines the Tech Level of the unit, there're 3 levels and each will appear in a different color in the GUI.
data.sections.core.altNames.description: Comma separated list of names. Like name but lower priority, useful for multiple optional mods.
data.sections.core.strictLevel.descripti: Defaults to 0. 1 = Errors if keys are duplicated. Add to "all-units.template" in root to apply to all units.
data.sections.core.isBio.description: Choose whether the unit is bioligical or not, affects sound and splat (unless hideScorchMark:true)
data.sections.core.isBug.description: Changes some death defaults, and sort order in Sandbox.
data.sections.core.isBuilder.description: Normally required if this unit places buildings. Defaults to [ai]useAsBuilder.
data.sections.core.streamingCost.descrip: Like price but paid for overtime while this unit is being queued or built. Construction or queue is paused if resources run out while building.
data.sections.core.switchPriceWithStream: Shortcut to set streamingCost to price value and clear price, add to all-units.template to quickly switch a mod over to streaming resources.
data.sections.core.maxShield.description: The max shield hitpoints of the unit. Can start with 0 hitpoints if startShieldAtZero:true.
data.sections.core.startShieldAtZero.des: Unit starts with a 0 hitpoints shield on created if true.
data.sections.core.energyMax.description: Defaults to 0. Energy that can be used as ammo for turrets, laser defense and actions.
data.sections.core.energyStartingPercent: Sets the percentage of charged energy when the unit is first built.
data.sections.core.energyNeedsToRecharge: Energy Needs to Recharge to Full
Disables weapons using energy after reaching zero till fully recharged if true.
data.sections.core.armour.description: Damage taken away from each hit. (not currently used in any vanilla units)
data.sections.core.armourMinDamageToKeep: Min damage to keep from received damage. Defaults to 1.
data.sections.core.borrowResourcesWhileA: Takes these resources when created and returns them when removed or destroyed.
data.sections.core.borrowResourcesWhileB: Like borrowResourcesWhileAlive but doesn't take affect till built. Mostly useful for buildings like houses that have negative resources to add to the unit cap, etc.
data.sections.core.generation_delay.desc: How often generation_resources/credits is added. Defaults to 40. (changing not recommended)
data.sections.core.showInEditor.descript: Set to false to hide unit in Sandbox editor. (Defaults to true)
data.sections.core.displayText.descripti: The unit name that the game shows to the player.
data.sections.core.displayText_es.descri: LANG = ISO 639-1 Code to show this text instead when game is in this language.
data.sections.core.displayDescription.de: Unit description that the game shows to the player.
data.sections.core.displayDescription_es: LANG = ISO 639-1 Code to show this text instead when game is in this language.
data.sections.core.displayLocaleKey.desc: Translation file key for unit name and description.
data.sections.core.displayRadius.descrip: Defaults to radius value. Set to show a larger or smaller selection circle UI on units.
data.sections.core.uiTargetRadius.descri: Defaults to displayRadius value. Radius used when attacking/reclaiming/etc this unit
data.sections.core.shieldRenderRadius.de: Defaults is a little bigger than radius. Set to show a larger or smaller shield circle on units.
data.sections.core.shieldDisplayOnlyDefl: Hide shield unless deflecting shot if true.
data.sections.core.shieldDeflectionDispl: Defaults to 4. High value causes shield deflection to fade disappear faster.
data.sections.core.showOnMinimap.descrip: Defaults to true. Hide units on minimap if false.
data.sections.core.showActionsWithMixedS: Shows a merged action list if all units selected includes one of these tags. Useful for converted units.
data.sections.core.isBuilding.descriptio: Defines if the unit is a building.
data.sections.core.footprint.description: Left, up, right, down. Tiles taken up which block unit movement. Defaults to 0,0,0,0  = 1 center tile.
data.sections.core.constructionFootprint: Tiles taken up for placement of other buildings. Defaults to 0,0,0,0 = 1 center tile.
data.sections.core.displayFootprint.desc: Left, up, right, down. Only applies to buildings, just used for GUI. Defaults to footprint.
data.sections.core.buildingSelectionOffs: Defaults to 0. Adds or removes padding on the drawn selection rect in UI.
data.sections.core.buildingToFootprintOf: Defaults to 10. Change the building position in the footprint on the X-axis.
Defaults to 10. Change the building position in the footprint on the Y-axis.
data.sections.core.placeOnlyOnResPool.de: Normally used for extractors, forces building construction in a resource pool.
data.sections.core.selfBuildRate.descrip: Rate unit builds itself when placed without a builder.
data.sections.core.ignoreInUnitCapCalcul: defaults to true for buildings otherwise false. Set to true to not count this unit in unit cap.
data.sections.core.copyFrom.description: Uses unit data from another ini file as default for this unit, supports multiple files.
data.sections.core.dont_load.description: Do not load unit, and don't error on missing data. Can be useful when used with copyFrom.
data.sections.core.overrideAndReplace.de: Overrides another unit with this unit. Build links and map positions to target unit will be replaced.
data.sections.core.onNewMapSpawn.descrip: Values: emptyResourcePools_asNeutral, emptyOrOccupiedResourcePools_asNeutral, mapCenter_asNeutral, mapCenter_eachActiveTeam, spawnPoint_eachActiveTeam (1.15)
data.sections.core.isLocked.description: Disallow building of this unit. Can be used with overrideAndReplace to restrict units player can build.
data.sections.core.isLockedIfGameModeNoN: Is Locked if Game Mode No Nuke
Disallows building of this unit if nukes are disabled during match setup.
data.sections.core.experimental.descript: Tag unit as experimental. Affects zoomed out icon and end game stats.
data.sections.core.stayNeutral.descripti: Set to false to disable capture when unit is on the neutral team.
data.sections.core.createNeutral.descrip: Set to true to always spawn the unit on the neutral team.
data.sections.core.createOnAggressiveTea: Set to true to always spawn the unit on aggressive teams on single player matches.
data.sections.core.tags.description: List of comma separated strings. Used to classify units, create special actions and balances.
data.sections.core.defineUnitMemory.desc: Can define several variables for custom storage, unique for each unit. Allowed types: boolean, float/number, unit, string.
data.sections.core.fogOfWarSightRange.de: Sets number of tiles this unit can see through the fog of war. Defaults to 15.
data.sections.core.fogOfWarSightRangeWhi: Fog of War Sight Range While Not Built
Fog of War range when unit/building is incomplete. Defaults to fogOfWarSightRange
data.sections.core.softCollisionOnAll.de: Creates a soft collision effect when touching other units.
data.sections.core.disableAllUnitCollisi: Unit cannot collide with others if true.
data.sections.core.isUnrepairableUnit.de: No unit can repair this unit if true.
data.sections.core.isUnselectable.descri: If true unit cannot be selected. (includes AI players)
data.sections.core.isUnselectableAsTarge: Defaults to isUnselectable. Can be used to create units that cannot be selected but can be targeted for attack, reclaim, etc
data.sections.core.isPickableStartingUni: If true, unit is added to dropdowns for starting unit in game setup menus.
data.sections.core.startFallingWhenStart: Unit will appear falling from skies when starting unit if true.
data.sections.core.soundOnAttackOrder.de: List of sound names. Only one will be played on each attack order. Only .ogg and .wav formats.
data.sections.core.soundOnMoveOrder.desc: List of sound names. Only one will be played on each move order. Only .ogg and .wav formats.
data.sections.core.soundOnNewSelection.d: List of sound names. Only one will be played on each unit selection. Only .ogg and .wav formats.
data.sections.core.canNotBeDirectlyAttac: No unit can directly target this unit. If true this will also skip this unit in victory/defeat checks. If true, canNotBeDamaged is true by default
data.sections.core.canNotBeDamaged.descr: Defaults to value of canNotBeDirectlyAttacked (be careful setting this without canNotBeDirectlyAttacked, as AI will attack forever)
data.sections.core.canNotBeGivenOrdersBy: Can Not Be Given Orders By Player
If true unit will not take player or AI orders.
data.sections.core.canOnlyBeAttackedByUn: Can Only Be Attacked By Units With Tags
List of tag strings, only units with these tags can directly target this unit.
Setting to true allows unit to continue living even at 0 HP, useful for custom "death" action. Warning: If not used with an autoTrigger, etc units will attack this unit forever.
data.sections.core.allowCaptureWhenNeutr: Allow Capture When Neutral By AI
When true, it lets to be captured on contact by AI as well. Defaults as false
Defaults to 1. Number of slots this unit uses up in a transport, experimentals are often set to 5.
Number of slots this units has for transporting other units.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsRequire: Only allows trasport of units that have one of these tags.
Only allows trasport of units that have one of these movement types.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsBlockAi: Transport Units Block Air And Water Units
Defaults to true. This unit can only transport LAND units if true.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsEachUni: Transport Units Each Unit Always Uses Single Slot
Defaults to false. Units in this transport occupy 1 slot always if true, ignoring transportSlotsNeeded.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsKeepBui: Makes built units stay inside transport instead of exiting it once ready if true.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsCanUnlo: Defaults to: if not self.isOverLiquid() and not self.isMoving(). This unit cannot unload units if false.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsAddUnlo: Defines if unload button should be added to the unit menu
data.sections.core.transportUnitsUnloadD: Transport Units Unload Delay Between Each Unit
Changes the delay it takes between each unit getting unloaded.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsKillOnD: Defaults to true. If false transported units don't die when transport dies.
Rate to heal units that are being transported.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsBlockOt: Defaults to true, if false this transports can hold other transports.
data.sections.core.whileNeutralTransport: This unit can transport units of any team while neutral if true.
data.sections.core.whileNeutralConvertTo: While Neutral Convert To Transported Team
Converts this unit to transported team while neutral. Useful with whileNeutralTransportAnyTeam.
data.sections.core.convertToNeutralIfNot: Convert To Neutral If Not Transporting
Reverts back this unit to neutral when unloaded. Useful with whileNeutralTransportAnyTeam.
data.sections.core.transportUnitsOnTeamC: Transport Units On Team Change Keep Current Team
Keeps transported units on their orginal team when this unit is converted if true.
data.sections.core.resourceRate.descript: Used with canReclaimResources. Allows other teams to reclaim this unit. Normally used with neutral team. Use price to set what resources are gained.
data.sections.core.similarResourcesHaveT: When this has been reclaimed harvester unit moves on to another resource with these tags.
data.sections.core.resourceMaxConcurrent: Defaults to unlimited. Set to restict how many units can reclaim this resource at the same time.
data.sections.core.reclaimPrice.descript: Like price but for resources. Useful for buildable resources.
data.sections.core.canReclaimResources.d: If true this unit can gather resources, useful with resourceRate.
data.sections.core.canReclaimResourcesNe: Can Reclaim Resources Next Search Range
Defines the resource search range of this unit when its main gathered resource runs out.
data.sections.core.canReclaimResourcesOn: Can Reclaim Resources Only With Tags
This unit is only allowed to gather resources with these tags.
data.sections.core.canReclaimUnitsOnlyWi: Can Reclaim Units Only With Tags
This is for reclaiming units, not for resources. See canReclaimResourcesOnlyWithTags
data.sections.core.resourceReclaimMultip: Multiplies the builder's reclaim speed. Different from the related key "nanoUnbuildSpeed"
data.sections.core.canRepairUnitsOnlyWit: Can Repair Units Only With Tags
Repairs units with the specified tags
data.sections.core.canRepairBuildings.de: Can this can heal ally buildings (isBuilder:true is required)
data.sections.core.canRepairUnits.descri: Can this can heal ally units. (isBuilder:true is required), canRepairBuildings required for buildings.
data.sections.core.autoRepair.descriptio: Automatically try and repair damaged units in nano range. (isBuilder:true is required)
data.sections.core.nanoRange.description: Defaults to 85. Defines the unit building/repair/reclaim range.
data.sections.core.nanoRepairSpeed.descr: Defaults to 0.2. Defines the unit nano repair/reclaim speed.
data.sections.core.nanoBuildSpeed.descri: Defaults to 1. Defines the unit nano building speed. (May multiply with target's buildSpeed)
data.sections.core.nanoUnbuildSpeed.desc: How fast a builder reclaims an incomplete building (defaults to 1)
data.sections.core.nanoReclaimSpeed.desc: How fast a builder reclaims a normal unit (not a resource unit)
data.sections.core.nanoRangeForRepairIsM: Nano Range For Repair Is Melee
Defines if this unit must touch its target to repair it.
data.sections.core.nanoRangeForReclaimIs: Nano Range For Reclaim Is Melee
Defines if this unit must touch its target to reclaim it.
data.sections.core.nanoRangeForRepair.de: Defines a specific range for the repair action of this unit.
data.sections.core.nanoRangeForReclaim.d: Defines a specific range for the reclaim action of this unit.
data.sections.core.nanoFactorySpeed.desc: Defaults to 1. Multiplies the buildSpeed value of the created unit if this unit is a factory.
data.sections.core.extraBuildRangeWhenBu: Extra Build Range When Building This
Temporarily adds extra build range to builders to build this unit. Useful for water based buildings.
data.sections.core.builtFrom_1_name.desc: Useful if adding this unit to build to existing buildings. Like canBuild but in opposite direction.
data.sections.core.builtFrom_1_pos.descr: Order this build link appears in UI. Using canBuild instead is more recommended.
data.sections.core.builtFrom_1_forceNano: Build as if this is a building if true. (even if it's a unit)
If true this unit cannot be built in this build link. (can be conditioned if logicBooleans are used)
data.sections.core.builtFrom_1_isLockedM: Message shown when this build link is locked.
data.sections.core.exit_x.description: Where created or unloaded units appears from the transport or building. Defaults to 0.
data.sections.core.exit_y.description: Where created or unloaded units appears from the transport or building. Defaults to 5.
data.sections.core.exit_dirOffset.descri: Defaults to 180 for units and 0 for buildings. Defines the exit direction of created or unloaded units.
data.sections.core.exit_heightOffset.des: Defaults to 0. Defines the height where created or unloaded units appears.
data.sections.core.exit_moveAwayAmount.d: Defaults to 70. Defines the distance that created or unloaded units moves from this unit.
data.sections.core.exitHeightIgnoreParen: Ignores parent height for exit height; useful for separating attachments with their parents for building
data.sections.core.dieOnConstruct.descri: Deletes this unit when it starts to build if true. (target building/unit likely will need selfBuildRate set)
data.sections.core.dieOnZeroEnergy.descr: Kills this unit if energy level reaches zero when true.
data.sections.core.numBitsOnDeath.descri: Defines the number of scattered bit fragments when this unit dies.
data.sections.core.nukeOnDeath.descripti: Unit will spawn a nuke detonation built-in effect when dies if true.
data.sections.core.nukeOnDeathRange.desc: Defines the nuke effect range when using nukeOnDeath.
data.sections.core.nukeOnDeathDamage.des: Defines the nuke effect area damage when using nukeOnDeath.
data.sections.core.nukeOnDeathDisableWhe: Nuke On Death Disable When No Nuke
Defaults to false. If true this unit will not explode with nuke when nukes are disabled in skirmish maps.
data.sections.core.fireTurretXAtSelfOnDe: Fire Turret X At Self On Death
Auto-shoot a specific turret when this unit dies.
data.sections.core.explodeOnDeath.descri: Defaults to true. Disables the unit death explode built-in effect if false.
data.sections.core.explodeOnDeathGroundC: Disables the explode built-in effect on death when unit touches ground if false.
data.sections.core.explodeTypeOnDeath.de: options: verysmall, small, normal, large, largeUnit, building, buildingNoShockwaveOrSmoke, verylargeBuilding
data.sections.core.effectOnDeath.descrip: Spawns built-in or custom effects when unit dies.
data.sections.core.effectOnDeathGroundCo: Like effectOnDeath but when unit touches ground. Useful for flying units.
data.sections.core.unitsSpawnedOnDeath.d: Spawns these units when dies. Comma separated unit identifiers.
data.sections.core.unitsSpawnedOnDeath_s: Units Spawned On Death Set To Team Of Last Attacker
Units spawned on death will appear on the last attacker team if true.
data.sections.core.hideScorchMark.descri: Disables the death scorch mark leaved when unit dies if true.
data.sections.core.soundOnDeath.descript: Sets a custom sound for this unit death.
data.sections.core.effectOnDeathIfUnbuil: If the unit was not completed, and is destroyed, play this effect. Defaults to effectOnDeath
data.sections.core.autoTriggerCooldownTi: Post automatic action cooldown (Not detection cooldown). Defaults to 1s. Warning: Setting this too low for many units might effect performance depending on the action effects.
Auto Trigger Cooldown Time Allow Dangerous High CPU
Allows for auto action cooldown lower than 0.2s. Default to false. Not recommended.
options: everyFrame (default), every4Frames, every8Frames. Note: all triggers regardless of check rate are checked when first created and after an auto trigger cooldown. Note: Adding [core]autoTriggerCheckRate:every8Frames to all-units.template could have a large performance boost for mods with complex autoTriggers.
data.sections.core.autoTriggerCheckWhile: Auto Trigger Check While Not Built
Defaults to false. autoTrigger of unit actions check even when not completely built if true
data.sections.core.updateUnitMemory.desc: Faster memory update than [action_#] setUnitMemory. Useful on many applications.
Sets how often the memory is updated. Defaults at 1s. settings it to 0 will update memory every frame.
data.sections.core.memory.description: A template-friendly method of defineUnitMemory. Declare name followed by type, separated by a colon
data.sections.core.action_1_price.descri: The price of your action for the unit. (All your sub actions will be linked to the # you use)
data.sections.core.action_1_text.descrip: A display text when you select your unit's action, used to explain it's purpose.
data.sections.core.action_1_addEnergy.de: Adds energy to unit. Has no effect unless energyMax is set
data.sections.core.action_1_whenBuilding: Stops unit moving while action is being applied. Useful for deploy like actions.
